Party changes inside rows, which a single value per row does not show. The 1990 merger falls inside the dual intervals of 한승수 (1988-12-05 to 1990-03-17), 김태호 (1989-07-19 to 1990-03-19) and 박철언 (1989-07-19 to 1990-04-18), who were 민정당 on the start date and 민자당 by the end.
